events.title: Oasis' Definitely Maybe turns 32
events.blurb: The iconic debut album from Oasis, "Definitely Maybe," was released on this day in 1994.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe Anniversary
angles.copy: 32 years since Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' and changed the game. What's your top track from this absolute classic?

events.title: Woodstock Festival: 57 years since the legendary event
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, took place over three days in August 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock Anniversary
angles.copy: 57 years ago, half a million people gathered for three days of peace, love, and music. What's your favourite Woodstock moment or performance?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: The music world remembers Elvis Presley, who passed away on this day in 1977.

angles.name: Elvis Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, today. His legacy continues to inspire generations. What's your all-time favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: The hip-hop world remembers influential artist Tupac Shakur, who tragically passed away on this day in 1996.

angles.name: Tupac Tribute
angles.copy: Today, we remember the lyrical genius and enduring impact of Tupac Shakur. What's the Tupac track that still resonates with you?

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: The music world remembers guitar legend Jimi Hendrix, who passed away on this day in 1970.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled talent of Jimi Hendrix, who left us too soon on this day in 1970. His guitar mastery remains unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road turns 57
events.blurb: The iconic Beatles album "Abbey Road" was released on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: 57 years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That iconic cover and timeless tracks – what's your favourite from the album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Her voice and style with The Pretenders are truly iconic. What's your favourite Pretenders hit?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: The iconic Oasis frontman and solo artist Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! From Oasis anthems to his solo hits, his sound is unmistakable. What's your top Liam track?

events.title: John Lennon's Imagine: 51 years since its release
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem "Imagine" was released as a single on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine Anniversary
angles.copy: 51 years since John Lennon released the powerful message of 'Imagine'. Its words are as relevant today as ever.

events.title: The original iPod turns 25
events.blurb: Apple introduced the very first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? 25 years ago, the original iPod dropped and changed music forever. What was your first iPod model?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the iconic film franchise.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! We're celebrating 007 and all his adventures. Who's your favourite Bond and what's the best Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The legendary Beatles co-founder and peace activist John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: John Lennon Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His music and message continue to inspire. What's your favourite Lennon song?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary comedian, actor, and Monty Python star John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is unmatched. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' White Album turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic self-titled double album, known as "The White Album," was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years of The Beatles' 'White Album'! A sprawling masterpiece with so many incredible tracks. Which one is your go-to?
